mapper.sql: select rider_evaluation_id, rider_base_id, user_id, order_id, rating, content, create_time from rider_evaluation
mapper.select: select re.rider_evaluation_id, re.rider_base_id, re.user_id, ub.nickname as user_nickname, re. order_id, om. order_no, re. rating, re.content, re.create_time from rider_evaluation re left join user_base ub on re.user_id = ub.user_base_id left join order_main om on re.order_id = om.order_main_id where re.rider_evaluation_id = #{riderEvaluationId}

select re.rider_evaluation_id, re.rider_base_id, re.user_id, ub.nickname as user_nickname, re.order_id, om.order_no, re.rating, re.content, re.create_time from rider_evaluation re left join user_base ub on re.user_id = ub. user_base_id left join order_main om on re. order_id = om.order_main_id where re. order_id = #{orderId}

select IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(rating), 1), 0.0) as avgRating, COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fiveStarCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fourStarCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as threeStarCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as twoStarCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as oneStarCount, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 0) as fiveStarRate, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 0) as fourStarRate, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 0) as threeStarRate, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 0) as twoStarRate, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0), 0) as oneStarRate from rider_evaluation where rider_base_id = #{riderBaseId}
